Subject: Update on Your Application for the Marketing Position

Dear [Candidate Name],

Thank you for taking the time to apply for the marketing position at [Company Name] and for sharing your qualifications with us. We truly appreciate the effort you put into your application.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely aligns with our current needs. Please know that this decision was not a reflection of your skills or potential, as we were impressed by your background. However, we are looking for a specific fit for this particular role.

We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers page, as we anticipate opening new positions in the future that may be a better match for your expertise. We wish you the very best in your job search and future professional endeavors.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Company Name]
